scripts.build:storybook: bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web build-storybook && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native build-storybook
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native typecheck && bun run --filter swarmie-mobile typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/web typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tests/fixtures/tembra-sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tembra/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/distribution/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/performance/tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @swarmie/plugin-context-browser typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/client typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run typegen && bun run lint:code
scripts.lint:design: oxlint --disable-nested-config --deny-warnings packages/ui/web/src packages/ui/native/src apps/web/src apps/web-client/src plugins/*/browser/src
scripts.test: bun run test:ui && bun run test:mobile && bun run test:web && bun run test:client && bun run test:perf
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.format:shared:check: node node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json packages/config packages/ui
scripts.check:ui: bun run format:shared:check && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-web typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui-native typecheck && bun run lint:shared
scripts.check:mobile: bun run --filter swarmie-mobile typecheck && bun run test:mobile && EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 bun run --cwd apps/mobile-client check:dependencies
scripts.typegen: bun run --filter @swarmie/web generate:routes && bun run --filter @swarmie/web cf-typegen
scripts.check:desktop: native check apps/desktop-client && native validate apps/desktop-client/app.json
scripts.dev:desktop: bun run ui:elements:prepare && bun run build:desktop:updater && bun scripts/distribution/desktop.ts dev
scripts.build:desktop:web: bun run ui:elements:prepare && bun run --filter @swarmie/client build --outDir ../desktop-client/dist
scripts.build:desktop: bun run build:desktop:web && bun scripts/distribution/desktop.ts build
